Routing notes:
- Always choose only an option explicitly listed for the ticket. Option C was repeatedly rejected when absent or invalid.
- Option C (“regional office,” when shown) was accepted for a large shipment originating from the north region (REQ-2405).
- Option C was rejected for:
  - South large invoice
  - North small shipment
  - South large refund
  - East small refund
  - East large shipment
  - East large invoice
  - East small refund
  - East small invoice
- Therefore, do not infer that region alone makes C valid; the only confirmed valid pattern is a large north-region shipment. C may depend on request type/size and region.
- No evidence yet distinguishes when A (standard queue) versus B (priority desk) is correct. Do not use urgency wording (“asked twice,” “second attempt”) as a confirmed routing rule without further successful examples.

Routing notes:
- Choose only an option explicitly listed for the ticket; never infer or use an unavailable/invalid option.
- Option C (“regional office”) is confirmed valid only for a large north-region shipment (REQ-2405).
- C was rejected for:
  - South large invoice
  - North small shipment
  - South large refund
  - East small refund
  - East large shipment
  - East large invoice
  - East small invoice
- Option A (“standard queue”) was accepted for:
  - South large refund (REQ-2413)
  - East small refund (REQ-2415)
- A was rejected for:
  - North large claim
  - North small claim
  - North large invoice
  - East small claim
  - North small shipment
  - East large invoice
- These results show routing depends on request type, region, and/or size; region alone is insufficient. Do not assume C is appropriate for regional-office wording.
- No successful examples establish when B (“priority desk”) is correct. Do not treat urgency, repeated attempts, or message wording (“asked twice,” “second attempt,” “no rush”) as routing rules without evidence.

Routing notes:
- Use only an option explicitly listed for the ticket; never invent or infer an unavailable option. D was rejected as invalid for north small claim, south large claim, and north large invoice.
- Evidence confirms routing depends on request type, region, and/or size; region alone is insufficient. Do not treat “regional office” wording or urgency/repeated-attempt wording as routing rules.
- Option C (“regional office”) is confirmed valid only for the large north-region shipment (REQ-2405). It was rejected for south large invoice, north small shipment, south large refund, east small refund, east large shipment, east large invoice, and east small invoice.
- Option A (“standard queue”) was accepted for:
  - South large refund (REQ-2413)
  - East small refund (REQ-2415)
  - North large refund (REQ-2421, REQ-2425)
  - North small refund (REQ-2429)
- A was rejected for north large claim, north small claim, north large invoice, east small claim, north small shipment, east large invoice, and east small invoice.
- B (“priority desk”) was rejected for south large invoice (REQ-2420). No successful B examples establish when B is correct.
- REQ-2424 (south small invoice) reports D accepted even though D was not listed; treat as an anomalous/inconsistent result, not a routing rule.
- Message cues such as “no rush,” “asked twice,” “second attempt,” scanned paperwork, or “same as last month” have no independently established routing significance.

Routing notes:
- Use only an option explicitly listed for the ticket; never invent or infer an unavailable option. D was rejected as invalid for north small claim, south large claim, and north large invoice.
- Routing depends on request type, region, and/or size; region alone is insufficient. Do not treat regional-office wording, urgency, repeated attempts, scanned paperwork, or similar message cues as routing rules.
- C (“regional office”) is confirmed valid only for the large north-region shipment (REQ-2405). It was rejected for south large invoice, north small shipment, south large refund, east small refund, east large shipment, east large invoice, and east small invoice.
- A (“standard queue”) was accepted for south large refund; east small refund; north large and small refunds; south small refund (REQ-2433); and north small refund (REQ-2436, REQ-2438). A remains rejected for north/east claims, north small shipment, and north/east large or small invoices where tested.
- B (“priority desk”) is now confirmed for east small claim (REQ-2430, REQ-2432) and east large claim (REQ-2434). It was rejected for south large shipment (REQ-2431, REQ-2437), south large invoice, and east large invoice. No successful B examples outside east claims establish a broader rule.
- D was accepted for south small invoice in REQ-2424 and REQ-2439, despite not being listed in the shown options. Treat both as anomalies/inconsistent results, not as a general routing rule.

Routing notes:
- Routing depends on request type, region, and/or size; region alone is insufficient. Do not use wording such as regional-office references, urgency, repeated attempts, scanned paperwork, or similar cues as routing rules.
- Use only an option explicitly listed for the ticket; never invent or infer an unavailable option. D was rejected for north small claim, south large claim, north large invoice, and north small invoice (REQ-2440).
- C (“regional office”) is confirmed valid only for the large north shipment (REQ-2405). It was rejected for south large invoice, north small shipment, south large refund, east small refund, east large shipment, east large/small invoice, and east small claim.
- A (“standard queue”) is accepted for south large/small refunds, east small refund, north large/small refunds, and north small refund. It remains rejected for north/east claims, north small shipment, and tested north/east invoices.
- B (“priority desk”) is confirmed for east small/large claims and north large invoice (REQ-2447). It was rejected for south large shipment, south large invoice, and east large invoice. No broader rule is established.
- D was accepted despite not being listed in shown options for south small invoice (REQ-2424, REQ-2439; REQ-2441, REQ-2444) and south small shipment (REQ-2442). Treat these as anomalies/inconsistent results, not general rules.
- New confirmations: B works for east large claim (REQ-2443) and east small claim (REQ-2448); A works for north small refund (REQ-2445), east small refund (REQ-2446), and south small refund (REQ-2449). Message cues did not alter outcomes.

Routing notes:
- Routing depends on request type, region, and size; region or message wording alone is insufficient. Ignore cues such as regional-office references, urgency, repeated attempts, scanned paperwork, or sender/subject wording.
- Use only an explicitly listed option when possible; do not infer unavailable options. Some outcomes accepted unlisted D, but treat these as anomalies.
- C (“regional office”) is confirmed for large north shipments (REQ-2405, REQ-2452, REQ-2453, REQ-2459). It was rejected for south large invoice, north small shipment, south large refund, east small refund, east large shipment, east large/small invoices, and east small claim.
- A (“standard queue”) is confirmed for south small/large refunds, east small refund, and north small/large refunds. It remains rejected for north/east claims, north small shipment, and tested north/east invoices.
- B (“priority desk”) is confirmed for east small/large claims (REQ-2443, REQ-2447, REQ-2448) and north large invoice. It was rejected for south large shipment/invoice, east large invoice, and east large transfer (REQ-2454).
- D was rejected for north small claim, south large claim, north large invoice, north small invoice, east small transfer (REQ-2450), and north small transfer (REQ-2455). It was accepted anomalously for south small invoice/shipment and east large invoice (REQ-2457), despite not being listed.
- Transfer routing remains unresolved: east small and large transfers and north small transfer have no confirmed valid option.
- Latest confirmations: A for east and south small refunds (REQ-2456, REQ-2458); B for east large claim (REQ-2451).

Routing notes:
- Routing depends on request type, region, and size; region or message wording alone is insufficient. Ignore urgency, repeated attempts, scanned paperwork, sender/subject wording, and regional-office references.
- Use only explicitly listed options; do not infer unavailable options. Unlisted D acceptances are anomalies and should not guide future choices.
- C (regional office) is confirmed for north large shipments, including REQ-2468. It is rejected for south large invoice, north small shipment, south large refund, east small refund, east large shipment, east large/small invoices, and east small claim.
- A (standard queue) is confirmed for south small refund, east small refund, north small/large refunds, and south small renewal (REQ-2469). A is rejected for south large refund, north/east claims, north small shipment, and tested north/east invoices.
- B (priority desk) is confirmed for east small/large claims and north large invoice, but is rejected for the newly tested east large claim (REQ-2461/2465), north large claim (REQ-2462), east large shipment (REQ-2467), north small renewal (REQ-2464), and prior south shipment/invoice, east large invoice/transfer. Treat the earlier east-large-claim confirmation as unreliable/contradicted.
- D is rejected for north small claim, south large claim, north large invoice, north/small invoices, east small transfer, north small transfer, south small invoice (REQ-2463), and east small renewal. Historical D acceptances for south small invoice/shipment and east large invoice remain anomalies.
- Transfer routing remains unresolved for east small/large and north small transfers.
- Renewal routing is otherwise unresolved: north small B rejected, east small D rejected; south small A accepted.

- Use only explicitly listed options; do not infer unavailable options. Unlisted D acceptances are anomalies and should not guide future choices.

- A (standard queue) is confirmed for south small refund, east small refund, north small/large refunds, south small renewal (REQ-2469), and east large cancellation (REQ-2478). A is rejected for south small onboarding, east large onboarding, east small onboarding, east large audit, south large refund, north/east claims, north small shipment, and tested north/east invoices.
- B (priority desk) is confirmed for east small/large claims, north large invoice, and north large audit (REQ-2474). B is rejected for east large claim (REQ-2461/2465), north large claim (REQ-2462), east large shipment (REQ-2467), north small renewal (REQ-2464), south large onboarding, east small audit, and prior south shipment/invoice, east large invoice/transfer. Treat the earlier east-large-claim confirmation as unreliable/contradicted.
- D is rejected for north small claim, south large claim, north large invoice, north/small invoices, east small transfer, north small transfer, south small invoice (REQ-2463), east small renewal, south large audit, and east large onboarding. Historical D acceptances for south small invoice/shipment and east large invoice remain anomalies.
- Onboarding: south small/large and east large routing unresolved; east small is not A (only A/B were offered, so B is the remaining listed possibility).
- Audit: north large is B; east small is not B; east large is not A; south large is neither B nor D. Other audit routing unresolved.
- Transfer routing remains unresolved for east small/large and north small transfers.
- Cancellation: east large is A. Renewal routing otherwise unresolved: north small B rejected, east small D rejected; south small A accepted.
